top_signals.title: Nvidia, SpaceX, Microsoft launch AI safety initiative as OpenAI cyber attack fallout continues
top_signals.summary: Microsoft, SpaceX, Palantir, alongside dozens of other tech companies from the U.S. and Europe, have joined the Open Secure AI Alliance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
